description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSkillDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, search filters, and skill permission checks related to EmployeeSkill data access.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeSkillDao data access operations, including CRUD, search filters, and related skill retrieval functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of EmployeeSkillDao and populates test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of EmployeeSkill by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple EmployeeSkills by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests searching EmployeeSkills with a filter parameter.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with a limit constraint.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new EmployeeSkill entity.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Tests updating an existing EmployeeSkill entity.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting EmployeeSkills matching a filter.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Tests retrieval of skills allowed for an employee, considering existing skills.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting skills allowed for an employee.
